verdict.rationale: JumpCloud's conditional access docs say access is revoked when a device falls out of compliance or the user is off a trusted network. Its first-party MDM manages Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS and Android, and JumpCloud Go ties login to managed devices, so device posture does gate app access. Missing for 10: documentation of the specific posture checks (encryption, screen lock, managed status) as policy conditions, evidence that posture is evaluated at SSO session grant rather than only revoked afterward, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
